name: Kimi K2.5
description: Moonshot AI's open-weights Mixture-of-Experts multimodal model, introducing Agent Swarm orchestration and visual agentic intelligence.
keyFeatures: Mixture-of-Experts architecture with ~1T parameters and 32B active per token
Incorporates MoonViT 400M parameter vision encoder for native multimodality
Agent Swarm architecture for task decomposition and multi-agent coordination
curatorNotes: The base foundation for Moonshot's Kimi K2 series, establishing the Agent Swarm paradigm.
